verdict.rationale: Stable pairs its virtual business address and mailbox with its own registered agent service: a nationwide service with automated filing guidance, prefilled forms, and API-created registered agent Locations tied to Company entities. That is a genuine entity service from the same provider. However, none of the three entity services the story names is evidenced. Missing for 10: LLC/entity formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, independent corroboration.
